triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); return !!(piece && piece.currentHp > 0); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return { success: false }; if (!piece.statusTags) piece.statusTags = []; if (!piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'divine-shield'; })) { piece.statusTags.push({ id: 'divine-shield', type: 'divine-shield', name: '圣盾', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1 }); } applyEffect(piece.instanceId, 'effect-divine-shield'); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '散发出神圣光辉，获得圣盾保护！' }; }
